skills.name: sdd-workflow
skills.description: Full SDD cycle: clarify requirements -> spec -> design -> task breakdown

skills.name: spdd-analyze
skills.description: Analyze requirements and scan codebase to surface domain concepts, risks, and design direction

skills.name: spdd-canvas
skills.description: Generate a complete REASONS Canvas from the latest analysis

skills.name: spdd-generate
skills.description: Implement code using strict TDD (Red -> Green -> Refactor) per Canvas Operations

skills.name: spdd-perftest
skills.description: Generate performance tests from the Canvas Safeguards and Requirements

skills.name: spdd-review
skills.description: Review the current implementation against the REASONS Canvas

skills.name: spdd-risk-review
skills.description: Validate that all risks are mitigated before any code is written

skills.name: spdd-story
skills.description: Break requirements or tasks into INVEST-compliant user stories

skills.name: spdd-sync
skills.description: Sync code changes back to the REASONS Canvas

skills.name: spdd-test
skills.description: Derive functional test scenarios from the Canvas for TDD implementation

skills.name: spdd-update
skills.description: Update the REASONS Canvas when requirements change (prompt-first rule)
